fact: As of 30 September 2026 the BCEAO lists 19 Malian institutions (14 banks, Moov Money, Sama Money, Orange Finances Mobiles Mali, Baobab, Cofina) authorised to open PI-SPI, the UEMOA instant payment system, to the public.
title: Liste des participants autorisés à ouvrir les services de PI-SPI au public
